description: The Luxembourg regulator ILR publishes an annual workbook of natural gas sector statistics on the national open data portal, built from data it collects from network operators and suppliers for market monitoring. Contents: infrastructure (distribution network data), consumption by customer group, domestic production including biomethane, prices, numbers of customers and supplier switching, imports by entry point and wholesale market figures; a companion dataset gives biogas injected into the natural gas networks, and the national geoportal serves a map of natural gas availability by cadastral section (526 features) as OGC API Features. Producer: the ILR, with the gas availability layer on geoportail.lu. Coverage: Luxembourg, national totals with some network operator detail; the time series run over several years. Format and access: one Excel workbook of about 94 KB, updated annually, downloadable without registration; an interactive dashboard on the ILR site shows the same figures. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution for the statistics and CC0 for geoportal layers. Caveats: network data are aggregated, not asset geometry; the availability map shows where gas supply exists, not pipeline routes. Simulation uses: calibrating gas demand in national energy system models, heat transition and electrification scenarios, and identifying areas without gas supply. Related records: ILR telecom coverage data (data-ilr-luxembourg-network-coverage-rgdr-and-telecom-statistics) come from the same regulator.
